### Added

- (agent-platform) [Say on a model's page when no context window is configured](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3219) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — A model's page under Customize's Models tab says `No context window is configured for this model` and whom to ask, when `agentPlatform.models.contextWindows` names none for it. `Created` shows a relative time, with the full date on hover.
- (agent-platform) [Show your actual model cost on Your sessions](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3226) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Usage's Your sessions view shows `Cost`: what your own model calls actually cost, in total and per agent, from the LLM gateway's per-user figures. Where those cannot be read it falls back to `Est. cost`, with the reason.
- (agent-platform) [Export a session from its actions menu](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3225) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — The session page's actions menu has `Export session`, which saves the whole session, every message and tool call as kagent stores it, as a JSON file.

### Fixed

- (app) [Let the notification inbox's toasts go on their own after 6 s](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3218) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Agent Platform notification toasts, for waiting sessions, failed or finished turns and MCP sign-ins, disappear on their own after 6 seconds, counted from when the window has focus. The notification bell keeps them.
- (muster) [A connector still connecting with the portal sign-in reads Connecting](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3224) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — Right after you sign in, a connector muster is still connecting with your portal sign-in reads `Connecting` in Customize's Connectors tab, and reaches its state without a reload.
- (muster) [Never ask a sign-in of an SSO connector, and say when one cannot connect](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3222) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Connectors that use your portal sign-in are no longer listed as needing your sign-in, not even briefly while the portal opens. One that refuses your sign-in reads `Cannot connect`, and its page says `<connector> cannot connect for you` and what an administrator has to change.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.18.0...v3.19.0
